description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for editing Dynamic DNS (DDNS) settings, including provider selection, user credentials, and hostnames. It contains server-side PHP code for retrieving and populating current DDNS configuration, as well as client-side JavaScript for form validation, dynamic hostname management, and AJAX submission.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Dynamically adds hostname input fields to the form for multiple host entries.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes specific hostname input elements from the form.
